applicationMap.label: Chronicle Overview
applicationMap.description: What Chronicle is, how every capability fits together, and where responsibility transfers next.

capabilities.label: Community Gallery
capabilities.description: How people discover, evaluate, save, play, review, remix, and publish shared stories.

capabilities.label: My Stories
capabilities.description: How drafts, saved community stories, published work, imports, exports, and play entry are managed.

capabilities.label: Character Library
capabilities.description: How reusable global characters are created, edited, selected, copied into stories, and kept separate from story-owned characters.

capabilities.label: My Images
capabilities.description: How private images are uploaded, organized, viewed, copied into consuming features, and deleted.

capabilities.label: Story Builder
capabilities.description: How a story's world, direction, cast, opening state, media, and publication readiness are assembled.

capabilities.label: Character Builder
capabilities.description: How story and library characters are authored, enhanced, validated, and persisted.

capabilities.label: Chat Interface
capabilities.description: The complete live roleplay lifecycle from player action through response construction, commit, support work, and evidence.

capabilities.label: Chat History
capabilities.description: How conversations are listed, resumed, paginated, identified, and deleted.

capabilities.label: Public Profile
capabilities.description: How creators edit their identity and how other users view, follow, and enter published work.

capabilities.label: Account Settings
capabilities.description: How authentication, account settings, subscription visibility, sessions, and account actions work.

capabilities.label: Admin Panel
capabilities.description: How privileged operators enter the Admin hub and use specialist tools without confusing documentation, diagnostics, validation, and operations.

capabilities.label: Shared Systems
capabilities.description: The shell, navigation, authentication, persistence, private media, caching, and shared state used across Chronicle.

capabilities.label: AI & API Services
capabilities.description: Shared provider transport, AI operations, support calls, usage accounting, and service-level failure boundaries.

capabilities.label: App Architecture Reference
capabilities.description: The exhaustive generated repository lookup that supports, but does not replace, the capability manuals.
